summary.zh: opinion-manager 的主 Skill 说明按 Profile 版本区分读取命令：2.1 声明用 context bundle，2.2 标签声明用 context select --tag；保留 fallback 时完整读取的条件。
summary.en: The opinion-manager Skill now tells agents which read command to use per Profile version: context bundle for 2.1 declarations, context select --tag for 2.2 tag declarations; the full-read fallback conditions are unchanged.
